name: Greyspire Hold
descriptionSeed: The westernmost dwarven hold, built on a grey spire above the southern forest's canopy. Dwarves and elves have argued across that tree-line for longer than either will admit, and traded across it for longer still.
encounterFlavor: dwarven wardens, timber-buyers, and elves who came up the stair to haggle and stayed to argue
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own mountain (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind").
appearance: A grey stone spire standing out of green canopy, walls wrapped round its crown, rope-lifts and a long stair down to the trees.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
